answer: Votes are weighted along a trellis of verified endorsements, so fake accounts must either burn real stake or recruit genuine backers who lose funds if the sybil misbehaves, making mass identity creation economically self-defeating. Each agent must lock a stake behind an on-chain anchor before voting, and every new identity needs a bridge endorsement from two staked peers who vouch with their own collateral at risk. From sa0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
